theorems.name: Submission.iwl_imc_restriction_im
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → (∀ (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), M₁ ⊆ U → M₂ ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ x ∈ M₁, 1 ≤ θ₁ x) → (∀ x ∈ M₂, 1 ≤ θ₂ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₂ θ₂ x Q) → ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsRestriction X A S → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
